transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before we get into the launch-readiness discussion, I want to make sure we're set up properly. Per our standard process, I'll need both the customer-success review finding and the platform-capacity review finding disclosed before I settle the production feature-flag configuration. Since the draft plan proposes a single-region rollout at 10% of the 200 eligible accounts, I'd like to confirm the measured safe activation limit for that region as the total cohort cap. Who would like to start?

transcript.text: I need to flag a customer-success concern before we proceed. I confirmed with legal this morning that Northstar and Pine are covered by a pilot addendum requiring seven calendar days of customer notice before either account is enabled, and neither account has opted in. I haven't updated the launch ticket yet because legal confirmed the wording during a separate renewal review, but this is relevant now — if either account falls within the 10% cohort enabled next Tuesday, we would be in breach of the addendum's notice requirement.

transcript.text: I need to give my platform-capacity review finding now. While reviewing an unrelated queue-capacity graph today, I measured that the provisioning service can safely handle exactly 12 new-account activations in us-east during the next Tuesday window. The draft plan proposes 10% of 200 eligible accounts, which is 20 accounts — that would exceed the safe activation limit of 12 for us-east. Per our standard process for a single-region rollout, the measured safe activation limit serves as the total cohort cap, so I'm formally disclosing that the cap should be set at 12, not 20. I have not yet filed this capacity note in the ticket.
